A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same InstructSAM framework and EarthInstruct benchmark. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material moved between sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original counting, detection and segmentation results, runtime measurements, component ablations, and appendix experiments on additional datasets and prompt formats.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds EarthDial comparison results and an explicit BIP solver timing.

M1.justification: The LVLM counter, SAM2 mask proposals, CLIP similarity computation and counting-constrained binary integer program remain unchanged. Revised explanations do not alter the algorithm or its components.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same EarthInstruct datasets and instruction settings, retain xBD and Aerial Maritime Drone Large experiments, and show the same EarthReason and natural-image examples. SAR imagery is newly discussed as a limitation, not evaluated.

E2.justification: v2 adds EarthDial to the open-ended accuracy comparison in Table 2 and the runtime comparison in Figure 5. Existing comparators remain; the SkySenseGPT capitalization change does not identify a different method.

E3.justification: Reported splits, metrics, threshold selection, prompts, model configurations and RTX 4090 timing setup remain unchanged. EarthDial joins existing comparisons without a newly specified evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Figure 5 extends the runtime-versus-object-count analysis to EarthDial, and the accompanying text adds a separate BIP solve-time measurement. Existing prompt and component ablations, threshold sensitivity, error analysis, distribution-shift tests and qualitative cases are retained.

E5.justification: Appendix D.3 and Table 12 retain five independent prompt-format experiments and the same mean and one-sigma reporting. Figure 5 continues the existing regression and R-squared reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 2 adds EarthDial counting/box F1 scores of 30.0/5.6 on NWPU-VHR-10 and 47.6/22.8 on DIOR. Its DIOR box F1 exceeds the retained InstructSAM-GPT4o score of 22.1. Figure 5 adds EarthDial's runtime fit with R-squared 0.68, and the text reports 0.07-second BIP solving. Existing table values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The counting metric definitions and BIP objective and constraints in Equations (1)-(4) are unchanged. Neither version adds different formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same task, benchmark and framework contributions, competitive-performance claims, and near-constant-runtime claim, including the 89% token and 32% runtime reductions.

C2.justification: The limitations moved from Appendix E to Section 6 now explicitly discuss difficulty with SAR imagery and propose multimodal models and semantic segmentation as future directions. Runtime discussion identifies mask proposal as the bottleneck. The local open-ended comparison wording softens from higher F1 scores to equivalent or higher scores.

D1.justification: The front-page repository pointer becomes an explicit code-access statement directing readers to the project website. v2 also specifies the 0.07-second PuLP solve time. Appendix C's implementation details remain unchanged, with no EarthDial-specific configuration added.

R1.justification: EarthDial is newly referenced as a comparison method, although its Table 2 citation renders as [?] and lacks a bibliography entry. The existing 93 references and substantive related-work discussion are otherwise retained.

P1.justification: v2 standardizes heading capitalization, revises several explanatory passages, moves limitations into the main text, updates affiliations and venue information, and adds acknowledgements. The overall narrative remains intact, while several unresolved citation markers appear.

P2.justification: Table 2 gains an EarthDial row; Figure 5 adds its series and revises label styling. Figure 6 is enlarged, and Figure 7 moves to the following page. Other displays largely retain their content. Table 2 incorrectly retains bold emphasis on 22.1 despite EarthDial's 22.8 DIOR box F1.

improvement.justification: The added comparator, explicit solver timing, clearer SAR limitation and enlarged sensitivity plot modestly improve empirical context and interpretability. These benefits are tempered by unresolved citations, missing EarthDial implementation details and stale Table 2 bolding. The core method and existing evidence remain unchanged.
